counterfactual.change: Removed the single emergency event at t=997; otherwise identical. Without preemption the cycle runs full yellow and all-red and no rule is violated.

explanation: Emergency preemption at t=997 forces an immediate switch from EW green/yellow to NS green: at 995 EW green, 996 EW yellow, 997 NS green. This skips the 2s all-red clearance (0s observed) and truncates EW yellow to 1s (needs 5s), violating all_red_clearance and yellow_duration. Removing the emergency removes the failure.
